window-1.title: Poolsuite FM
window-1.blurb: It's an entire sun-bleached 90s computer desktop that plays endless summer radio — the kind of committed-to-the-bit web world you'll want to steal interface ideas from while it scores your next side quest.

window-2.title: Naive Weekly
window-2.blurb: It's a weekly letter from the quiet corners of the internet — hand-made sites, net art, digital gardens — basically the reading version of every web toy you've ever fallen down a hole with.

window-3.title: Calamansi Sparkling Margarita Mocktail
window-3.blurb: A margarita rerouted through calamansi — that auntie-kitchen citrus you already know by heart — salted rim and all, and endlessly riffable with a chilli-salt rim or a float of pandan syrup.

window-4.title: Earthy, Layered Interiors in a Notting Hill Apartment
window-4.blurb: This one's a masterclass in making a room feel warm through texture alone — clay tones, worn textiles, soft pools of lamplight — and I think it'd be a dream reference for that lived-in corner you keep almost building.

window-5.title: Yunma Bakehouse, Purvis Street
window-5.blurb: A brand-new bakehouse hiding behind construction scaffolding off Purvis Street slinging $2.20 pastries — go now, shoot it on film, and feel smug that you found it before the hoarding comes down.
